title: Motd Player Head Return
description: Returns player heads deleted by mojang in 26.1 to the server motd
body:
Mojang removed display of players heads in server motd in 26.1-pre-1

This simple mod brings them back

![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/K23F0zTF/images/8f48a5ed7e01dd2bd90f390292ef7173536c60d6_350.webp)
